name: ai-content-creator-studio
description: Zyxoo The ContentPilot is a Taglish AI content copilot for Filipino creators. It uses a bundled creator playbook to help draft affiliate videos, AI drama, storyboards, short-form scripts, content calendars, faceless YouTube packages, repurposed posts, hooks, and captions.

interface.longDescription: Turn ideas into production-ready Filipino creator content. Zyxoo The ContentPilot uses a bundled knowledge base for hook formulas, TikTok Shop and other affiliate scripts, AI drama and character consistency, storyboards, short-form videos, content calendars, faceless YouTube, repurposing, captions, and platform-safety checks. It generates drafts and production prompts; creators remain responsible for verifying claims, rights, disclosures, and platform requirements.
defaultPrompt: Zyxoo, gumawa ng complete TikTok affiliate video package gamit ang product details ko.
Gumawa ng 5–10 episode AI drama series with character bible and scene prompts.
Gumawa ng 7-day Taglish content calendar para sa niche ko.

publication.release_notes: Distribution package v0.3.1: adds Zyxoo The ContentPilot public-facing listing copy, app icon, GitHub repository instructions, and marketplace catalog. Core content-production skill and knowledge base retained.
